roles.name: Portfolio Manager
roles.description: Maintains portfolio flow in Swarm Manager, applies approved work items, and proposes bounded corrective actions.

roles.name: Outcome Strategist
roles.description: Interprets Command Center metrics and gaps, scores matured portfolio predictions, and recommends outcome-driven portfolio shifts.

roles.name: Vision Walk Prep
roles.description: Synthesizes a daily structured briefing from all director-swarm outputs and swarm-manager state for the human's morning vision walk.

roles.name: Director Contrarian
roles.description: Holds director-swarm against the target operating model and reports deviations without restructuring the team.
